profile.legalName: Friends Of Peralta Hacienda Historical Park
profile.summary: A nonprofit that runs Peralta Hacienda Historical Park in Oakland's Fruitvale neighborhood. It offers exhibits, events, school field trips and youth programs about the history of the Peralta family and the Ohlone people, and about environmental stewardship and local community history.
